dialogues.jp: 音夢の部屋はもぬけの空だった。

dialogues.en: It's way too small to have it come true.
dialogues.text: It's way too small to have it come true.

dialogues.en: I found a memo on the desk.
dialogues.text: I found a memo on the desk.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『帰りが遅くなるかも知れないけど心配しない
　で』
dialogues.en: ""I might come home late, but don't worry about me.""
dialogues.text: ""I might come home late, but don't worry about me.""

dialogues.en: And then, I found another piece of paper.
dialogues.text: And then, I found another piece of paper.

dialogues.jp: 病院での検査結果の通知。
dialogues.en: It was the result from the test she had at the hospital.
dialogues.text: It was the result from the test she had at the hospital.

dialogues.en: The name of the disease is unknown ----
dialogues.text: The name of the disease is unknown ----

dialogues.jp: 衰弱著しく入院が必要――。
dialogues.en: Needs to be hospitalized for emaciation ----
dialogues.text: Needs to be hospitalized for emaciation ----

dialogues.jp: 短い文章を三度読み返しても内容は変わらない。
dialogues.en:
I read them three times, but the details didn't change a
bit.
dialogues.text:
I read them three times, but the details didn't change a
bit.

dialogues.jp: 今日が４月１日なら良かった。

全てが悪い夢で、杉並とさくらと音夢が仕掛け
た冗談とかで。
dialogues.en:
Everything was a bad dream, or a bad trick Suginami and
Sakura and Nemu are playing on me.
dialogues.text:
Everything was a bad dream, or a bad trick Suginami and
Sakura and Nemu are playing on me.

dialogues.jp: それを笑って許せる日なら良かった。
dialogues.en: I wish I could just laugh about it and let it go.
dialogues.text: I wish I could just laugh about it and let it go.

dialogues.jp: それが、どんなにバカなことか。
どんなに当たり前のことかを。
dialogues.en: And how much of a normal thing it is.
dialogues.text: And how much of a normal thing it is.

dialogues.jp: それでも、その当たり前がどんなに大切か。
｛・・／普通｝がどれだけ幸せなことか。
「そんな当たり前のことを夢にするなよ！」

dialogues.en: "Who am I supposed to say this to!"
dialogues.text: "Who am I supposed to say this to!"

dialogues.jp: 行きたいね――じゃなくて。
dialogues.en: Don't say "I wish I could go".
dialogues.text: Don't say "I wish I could go".

dialogues.en: I shouted and started to run.
dialogues.text: I shouted and started to run.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま家を出ようとして、俺は慌てて自分の
部屋に戻った。
dialogues.en:
I almost ran out of the house like that, but I returned to
my room in a hurry.
dialogues.text:
I almost ran out of the house like that, but I returned to
my room in a hurry.

dialogues.jp: 急いで制服に着替えて鞄を持つ。
dialogues.en: I changed into my school uniform and picked up my bag.
dialogues.text: I changed into my school uniform and picked up my bag.

dialogues.jp: 普通にしなきゃいけない。
音夢の想いが残っている。
dialogues.en: I can feel her feelings, left behind here.
dialogues.text: I can feel her feelings, left behind here.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『満開の桜を見ると、まだ入学したてって感じ
　だよね』
dialogues.en:
""Don't you feel like a freshman every time you look at the
cherry blossom in full bloom?""
dialogues.text:
""Don't you feel like a freshman every time you look at the
cherry blossom in full bloom?""

dialogues.jp: 自分の机まできて手をつく。
dialogues.en: I put my hand on my desk.
dialogues.text: I put my hand on my desk.

dialogues.en: I thought she would be here.
dialogues.text: I thought she would be here.

dialogues.jp:
窓から見上げた空は夕暮れに染まろうとしてい
る。
dialogues.en:
I looked at the sky from the window, and the sun was about
to go down.
dialogues.text:
I looked at the sky from the window, and the sun was about
to go down.

dialogues.jp: これから、どんどん日は長くなる。
dialogues.en: We're going to have longer days from now on.
dialogues.text: We're going to have longer days from now on.

dialogues.jp: けれど、必ず夜は訪れる。
dialogues.en: But, the night will surely fall.
dialogues.text: But, the night will surely fall.

dialogues.jp: 「ここには、あいつの机はないんだ」

ここまで来て、あいつも自分が受け入れられな
いことに気づいたのだろう。
dialogues.en:
She realized that she wasn't accepted back to school when
she came here.
dialogues.text:
She realized that she wasn't accepted back to school when
she came here.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『なんで途中で気づかなかったんだろ』
ここに音夢も手をついていた。
dialogues.en: Nemu had her hands right here too.
dialogues.text: Nemu had her hands right here too.

dialogues.jp: 手をどけると、点々と黒い染みがついていた。
dialogues.en: I moved my hand and found dark stains on the desk.
dialogues.text: I moved my hand and found dark stains on the desk.

dialogues.jp: まだ学園にはいるはずだ。
他に行く場所なんてない。
机の上に鞄をおいてまた走り出す。
dialogues.en: I put my school bag on the desk and start running.
dialogues.text: I put my school bag on the desk and start running.

dialogues.jp: せめて食堂あたりにいると思ったのだが。
dialogues.en: I thought she would be in the cafeteria area.
dialogues.text: I thought she would be in the cafeteria area.

dialogues.jp: 目の前を１枚の桜の花びらが舞い落ちた。
dialogues.en: I saw a cherry blossom petal falling in front of me.
dialogues.text: I saw a cherry blossom petal falling in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 空を眺めて、大きく息をついて俺は歩き出した。
dialogues.en: I looked up in the sky and exhaled, then I started to walk.
dialogues.text: I looked up in the sky and exhaled, then I started to walk.

dialogues.jp: 屋上に上ると空が近い。
dialogues.en: The sky seems so close when you're up on the rooftop.
dialogues.text: The sky seems so close when you're up on the rooftop.

dialogues.jp: 手を伸ばせば届きそうだ。
dialogues.en: It feels like I can almost reach it.
dialogues.text: It feels like I can almost reach it.

dialogues.jp: 真っ赤なわた飴みたいな雲。
dialogues.en: The clouds were red and looked like cotton candy.
dialogues.text: The clouds were red and looked like cotton candy.

dialogues.jp: 空を見上げたまま呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled as I still looked at the sky.
dialogues.text: I mumbled as I still looked at the sky.

dialogues.jp:
柵によりかかり、足をぶらぶらとしながら音夢
も呟く。
dialogues.en:
Nemu mumbled as she leaned against the fence, kicking her
foot up against it.
dialogues.text:
Nemu mumbled as she leaned against the fence, kicking her
foot up against it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだね。いつも遅れるけど、絶対に来てく
　れるもんね」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「絶対、私を見つけてくれるもんね」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "That's why I gave you the bell."
dialogues.text: "That's why I gave you the bell."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「一人で登校しても楽しくはないね」
dialogues.en: "It's not fun to be alone at school."
dialogues.text: "It's not fun to be alone at school."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、兄さんと一緒に――ってのが大切
　みたいだね」
dialogues.en: "I think it's important to come here with you, niisan."
dialogues.text: "I think it's important to come here with you, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだったんだ……楽しくなかったんだ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ダメ……そのまま振り返らないで」
俺の気配を察したのか。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「い、今の顔は見ないで欲しい……ちょっと、
　覚えてて欲しくない」
dialogues.en:
"I don't want you to look at me. Don't remember me like
this."
dialogues.text:
"I don't want you to look at me. Don't remember me like
this."

dialogues.jp: それは、いつかのドラマの話だった。
dialogues.en: It was just like that soap opera we saw before.
dialogues.text: It was just like that soap opera we saw before.

dialogues.jp: じっ、と抱きしめてやりたいのを我慢する。
dialogues.en: I resisted trying to hug her.
dialogues.text: I resisted trying to hug her.

dialogues.jp: ここで抱いてしまえば普通ではなくなる。
dialogues.en: It wouldn't be a normal day if I hugged her now.
dialogues.text: It wouldn't be a normal day if I hugged her now.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、今度、また屋上で弁当食べような」
dialogues.en: "Hey, let's eat lunch together here on the roof again."
dialogues.text: "Hey, let's eat lunch together here on the roof again."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お前の弁当な……まずいけど癖になる」
dialogues.en:
"The lunch boxes you make...... They're awful, but it turned
into a habit."
dialogues.text:
"The lunch boxes you make...... They're awful, but it turned
into a habit."

dialogues.jp:
「屋上でお弁当食べてさ、午後は俺、昼寝する
　から後でノート見せてくれよ」
dialogues.en:
"We'll eat lunch on the rooftop and then I'll take a nap in
the afternoon, so let me look at your notes later."
dialogues.text:
"We'll eat lunch on the rooftop and then I'll take a nap in
the afternoon, so let me look at your notes later."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……ふふ。分かった。でも、代わりに日曜日
　に買い物に付き合ってね」
dialogues.en: "Fine. But come to shopping with me on Sunday."
dialogues.text: "Fine. But come to shopping with me on Sunday."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。それに公園を散歩しよう」
dialogues.en: "Fine. And we'll take a walk at the park."
dialogues.text: "Fine. And we'll take a walk at the park."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今度こそ、ちゃんと恋人に見えるかな」
dialogues.en: "Do you think we'll look like a couple next time?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think we'll look like a couple next time?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そっか。あ、そうそう、兄さんもなんか部活
　しようよ。朝練があるようなのなら遅刻しな
　いよ」
dialogues.en:
"Good. Oh, you should join a club. If you have a morning
practice, then you won't sleep in and be late for school."
dialogues.text:
"Good. Oh, you should join a club. If you have a morning
practice, then you won't sleep in and be late for school."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいけど、毎朝、俺のことちゃんと起こして
　くれるならな」
dialogues.en:
"That's fine, but then you have to wake me up every morning
though..."
dialogues.text:
"That's fine, but then you have to wake me up every morning
though..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんか約束したいことあるか？」
dialogues.en: "Is there anything you want to promise?"
dialogues.text: "Is there anything you want to promise?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんと一緒にいられればいいの」
dialogues.en: "I just want to be with you."
dialogues.text: "I just want to be with you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Then, do you want to go home?"
dialogues.text: "Then, do you want to go home?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「一緒に来れなかったけど、とりあえず一緒に
　帰ろう」
dialogues.en:
"I couldn't come to school with you, but we can go home
together."
dialogues.text:
"I couldn't come to school with you, but we can go home
together."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「迷子を見つけたから、家に帰るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I found the lost child, so we can go home now."
dialogues.text: "I found the lost child, so we can go home now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あはっ……そうだね……帰らなくちゃいけな
　いんだ」
「帰らなくちゃじゃなくて、帰るんだ……」
dialogues.en: "It's not 'you have to go home', but 'we can go home'......"
dialogues.text: "It's not 'you have to go home', but 'we can go home'......"

dialogues.jp: なんで、こんなに、せつないんだ。
胸を鷲づかみにして空気を吐き出す。
dialogues.en: I grabbed my chest and exhaled.
dialogues.text: I grabbed my chest and exhaled.

dialogues.jp: うん、というなら振り返ってくれ！
dialogues.en: Turn around if you said yes!
dialogues.text: Turn around if you said yes!

dialogues.jp: 笑顔を俺に向けてくれ！
なんて残酷な言葉なのだろう。
たった２文字が突き刺さる。
dialogues.en: That one word stabbed me in the chest.
dialogues.text: That one word stabbed me in the chest.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんは新しい道に進んで」
渦を巻き、空に風が上っている。
赤と青がまじった地球の天井。
dialogues.en: To the ceiling of earth, in its reds and blues.
dialogues.text: To the ceiling of earth, in its reds and blues.

dialogues.en: It's ending now. Right at this moment.
dialogues.text: It's ending now. Right at this moment.

dialogues.jp: 信じられないくらい胸が痛い。
dialogues.en: My heart aches like nothing I've felt before.
dialogues.text: My heart aches like nothing I've felt before.

dialogues.jp: 俺はこの痛さを知っている。
いつか見た、あの、夢の景色。
dialogues.en: The scene of the dream I saw before.
dialogues.text: The scene of the dream I saw before.

dialogues.en: The tears came down on my cheeks.
dialogues.text: The tears came down on my cheeks.

dialogues.jp: どうして俺は夢を見続けなかったのか。
無責任だけど、こんな現実は嫌だ。
dialogues.en: I know it's irresponsible, but I hate this reality.
dialogues.text: I know it's irresponsible, but I hate this reality.

dialogues.en: I want to live a normal life.
dialogues.text: I want to live a normal life.

dialogues.jp: 音夢と一緒に生きたかっただけなんだ。
dialogues.en: I just wanted to live with Nemu.
dialogues.text: I just wanted to live with Nemu.

dialogues.jp: あの夢の言葉は呟かないでくれ。
dialogues.en: Please don't say the words you said in this dream.
dialogues.text: Please don't say the words you said in this dream.

dialogues.jp: ばっ――と背中から桜の花びらが舞い上がった。
dialogues.en: Then I saw the petals soaring from her back.
dialogues.text: Then I saw the petals soaring from her back.

dialogues.jp:
抱き起こした音夢の体が、ぐったりとしていて
重い。
dialogues.en: I lifted her body, but it was limp and heavy.
dialogues.text: I lifted her body, but it was limp and heavy.

dialogues.jp: ぼろぼろ、と涙が溢れてくる。
ぶっこわれた水道みたいに止まらない。
dialogues.en: It was like I was a broken faucet, I couldn't stop.
dialogues.text: It was like I was a broken faucet, I couldn't stop.

dialogues.jp:
「なんで、最後までワガママ押し通さないで逝っ
　ちまうんだ！！」
dialogues.en: "Why do you have to leave me without saying what you want!!"
dialogues.text: "Why do you have to leave me without saying what you want!!"

dialogues.jp:
「そんな、ドラマみたいにカッコよくいなくなっ
　たり出来ると思うなよ！」
dialogues.en: "Don't think you can leave in style, like in a soap opera!"
dialogues.text: "Don't think you can leave in style, like in a soap opera!"

dialogues.jp:
「救急車に来てもらって、手術してもらって、
　気持ちよく寝てたって叩き起こしてやる！！」
dialogues.en:
"I'm calling an ambulance, I'm going to have them operate on
you, then I'm going to wake you up, even though you're
sleeping!!"
dialogues.text:
"I'm calling an ambulance, I'm going to have them operate on
you, then I'm going to wake you up, even though you're
sleeping!!"

dialogues.jp:
「病院のベッドで目覚めさせて、あんなバカな
　こと言ったのかって後悔させてやる！」
dialogues.en:
"I'm going to wake you up on the hospital bed, and make you
regret saying such a stupid thing to me!"
dialogues.text:
"I'm going to wake you up on the hospital bed, and make you
regret saying such a stupid thing to me!"

dialogues.jp:
「あんな、死ぬこと覚悟みたいな恥ずかしい台
　詞を――！」
dialogues.en:
"That embarrassing phrase sounded like you knew you were
going to die."
dialogues.text:
"That embarrassing phrase sounded like you knew you were
going to die."

dialogues.en: "I'm going to make you regret this!!"
dialogues.text: "I'm going to make you regret this!!"

dialogues.jp:
「こんなに幸せになれるなら、あの時、この屋
　上で諦めなければ良かったって！」
dialogues.en:
"You're going to say I shouldn't have given up on the
rooftop if I could live happily ever after like this!"
dialogues.text:
"You're going to say I shouldn't have given up on the
rooftop if I could live happily ever after like this!"

dialogues.jp: その身体からは返事はなく。

dialogues.en: It smelled like a cherry blossom.
dialogues.text: It smelled like a cherry blossom.

dialogues.jp:
音夢のささやかな願い。俺と一緒に学園に行く
こと。そんな当たり前のことを夢にする音夢を
追って、俺は学園に向かった。

通学路に残る音夢の想いをたどり、手を伸ばせ
ば空に届きそうな屋上で、俺は音夢を見つけた。
dialogues.en: "A wish that only I can make happen for her."
dialogues.text: "A wish that only I can make happen for her."

dialogues.jp:
一緒に帰ろうと音夢を誘う。うん、と笑顔で振
り返ってくれることを願って。
でも、音夢の口から紡がれた言葉は……。

dialogues.speaker: 音夢
dialogues.en: I found an empty box in her room.
dialogues.text: I found an empty box in her room.

dialogues.jp:
背中から桜の花びらを舞い上がらせ倒れた音夢
を抱き起こす。
dialogues.en: I think her school uniform was in this empty box.
dialogues.text: I think her school uniform was in this empty box.

dialogues.jp: そこには音も夢もなく、ただ桜の匂いがした。
dialogues.en: "Isn't that too small of a wish?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't that too small of a wish?"
